name: ab-hook-testing
description: Generate parallel A/B hook variants for the ecc-hormozi-funnel skill, review each independently for compliance and evidence, and gate human approval before sending to outreach
diagram:
```mermaid
graph TD
  Plan[plan-campaign] --> VA[generate-variant-a]
  Plan --> VB[generate-variant-b]
  Plan --> VC[generate-variant-c]
  VA --> RevComp[review-compliance]
  VB --> RevComp
  VC --> RevComp
  VA --> RevBrand[review-brand-fit]
  VB --> RevBrand
  VC --> RevBrand
  RevComp --> Syn[synthesize-variants]
  RevBrand --> Syn
  RevComp -.->|failure| VA
  RevComp -.->|failure| VB
  RevComp -.->|failure| VC
  Syn --> Gate[human-gate-send]
```

nodes.responsibility: Define the outreach campaign objective and creative constraints for hook generation
Generate hook variant A using a bold value-proposition angle
Generate hook variant B using an emotional pain-point angle
Generate hook variant C using a data-driven evidence angle
Check whether all hook variants comply with outreach platform policies and avoid fabricated claims
review_questions: Do all hook variants avoid fabricated scarcity, guarantees, prices, and unverified claims per ECC safety rules?

nodes.responsibility: Check whether all hook variants align with the ECC brand voice and positioning
review_questions: Do all hook variants align with the established ECC brand voice and avoid generic AI writing tropes?

nodes.responsibility: Merge the surviving hook variants into a final ranked test plan
Human reviews the test plan and approves outreach before any messages are sent
